subject: VPC & On-Prem Hardening — ISO27001 evidence and deployment constraints
messages:
From: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@acmehealth.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VPC & On-Prem Hardening — ISO27001 evidence request

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — Acme Health is excited about Redwood Private. As part of our security review and ISO27001 alignment we need a concise package of evidence and short answers to a few deployment-level questions before we can advance to final procurement. Can you confirm the following items (high level is fine for now):

1) Do you have an ISO27001 certificate or a documented scope and self-assessment we can review?
2) Network hardening: recommended VPC topology, bastion/jump host approach, port lists, egress rules, and whether you recommend private endpoints only.
3) Patching/maintenance windows: expected schedule for on-prem appliance (or VM) updates and support for offline patching in air-gapped environments.
4) Key management: support for customer-managed KMS/HSM (bring-your-own-keys), and any FIPS-compliant modules.
5) SBOM and supply chain: can you provide a runtime SBOM and update cadence?
6) Evidence for cryptographic controls (TLS versions, cipher suites, certificate rotation).
7) Any constraints around our PKI (do you require specific CA chains, or do you support custom root CAs for mTLS?).

It would be great to get a one-page artifact checklist and an estimated delivery timeline. I attached the RFP for context. Could we schedule a 45-minute call early next week to walk through details?

Thanks,
Jared Bloom
Head of Security, Acme Health
[jared.bloom@acmehealth.com]
Attachment: Acme_RFP_2027.pdf
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC & On-Prem Hardening — ISO27001 evidence request

Hi Jared —

Appreciate the clear asks and the RFP. Short answers below and I attached a concise summary pack for your security team. High-level responses:

1) ISO27001: Redwood Inc (parent) maintains an ISO27001 program; for Redwood Private we provide a scoped self-assessment and controls mapping. See attached "Redwood_ISO27001_SelfAssessment.pdf" and the hardening summary.

2) Network topology: we recommend a three-subnet model (control plane, inference nodes, management/bastion). Bastion must be placed in a management subnet with restricted ingress; we strongly prefer private endpoints for control-plane communications and support hardened egress via proxy appliances. Exact port lists will be included in the hardening guide.

3) Patching: for on-prem appliances we ship signed update bundles. Customers can choose: automatic rolling updates scheduled off-peak, or manual offline patch artifact import for air-gapped environments. Typical cadence: security patches monthly, feature releases quarterly.

4) KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, on-prem HSMs via PKCS#11). FIPS 140-2 compliant modules are supported in Dedicated/Private builds; we can provide a compatibility matrix.

5) SBOM: runtime SBOM generated per build; cadence tied to release pipeline. We include component versions and attestations.

6) Crypto controls: TLS 1.2+ with preferred TLS 1.3, modern cipher suites only. Certificate rotation supported via API, and we provide recommended rotation policies.

7) PKI: we support custom root CAs and mTLS using customer-provided certificates. If you want us to install CA bundles, we can accept signed root CA artifacts through an officer-signed intake process.

Next steps: I'll schedule a 45-min call (proposed slots in calendar invite). For artifacts I attached a one-page "Redwood_Private_Hardening_Summary.pdf". Kimberly (cc'd) will lead artifact collection and produce an index CSV of evidentiary items.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_Private_Hardening_Summary.pdf

Thanks Markus — this is useful. A couple of follow-ups before the call:

• Can you produce the scoped ISO27001 certificate or the self-attestation mapping that covers Private (we need the specific control numbers and any exclusions)?
• For our auditors: can you provide copy of SOC2 (if available) and a sample SBOM export for a recent release?
• KMS/HSM: can you confirm support for Luna HSM v7 and that we can import external keys into the runtime?
• Air-gapped installs: what is the maximum size of the signed update bundle and do you provide a secure checksum/signature verification process we can validate in our pipeline?

If you can drop the artifact index into a shared folder before our call that will help speed things up.

-Jared
